classification.difficultyReason: Construct a labelled Venn diagram by allocating integers to the intersection, exclusive regions and complement.

content.prompt:
$\xi=\{\text{integers from }-5\text{ to }5\text{ inclusive}\}$

$A=\{-2,0,2,4\}$, $B=\{-3,-2,-1,0,1,2\}$

Draw a Venn diagram to represent this information.

answer.worked: Place the common elements $-2,0,2$ in the overlap. Place $4$ in $A$ only and $-3,-1,1$ in $B$ only. Place the remaining elements of $\xi$, namely $-5,-4,3,5$, outside both circles but inside the rectangle.

spec.description: Rectangular universal set with overlapping circles A on the left and B on the right. All labels and elements are editable black mathematics; source answer colouring is omitted.
spec.answerVisibility: Answer editions only; no completed diagram in the student prompt.
